name: Babi: Baby Care & Daily Guide
subtitle: Dress, Pack, Plan the day
description:
Babi answers the question every parent asks before opening the front door: what does the baby need right now?

It reads today's weather, UV and air quality where you are, and turns them into plain answers — an outfit, a good hour to be outside, a bag that is already packed for the weather at pickup. No logging, no charts, no streaks.

Everything is one sentence and one picture. Babi is read one-handed, at 6 a.m., by someone who has been awake since three, so every screen gives its answer before you have finished looking at it.

WHAT TO WEAR
Babi suggests layers for the way you are actually going out: in the stroller, in a carrier, in the car seat, or walking. It accounts for your baby's age, whether they run warm or cool, and what the air will feel like — not just what the thermometer says. Every suggestion shows its reasoning, and you can tell Babi it was too warm or too cool so the next one is closer.

BEST TIME OUTSIDE
A single window, not a wall of numbers: when today is comfortable, when the UV is worth avoiding, and when the air is clean enough. Babi works around nap times you have told it about, so a suggested window is one you could actually take.

THE BAG, ALREADY PACKED
A diaper bag sized to how long you will be out, and a daycare bag built from the day's weather — a rain suit added because rain is likely at pickup, a sun hat added because the UV peaks during outdoor play. Tick items off one-handed. Your partner sees the same list update.

TONIGHT
What to put the baby in for the room you actually have, using TOG values and the sleep sacks you own. Enter the room temperature or read it from a sensor in Apple Home. Safe-sleep guidance from the AAP is one tap away, and Babi never suggests anything that works against it.

ON EVERY SCREEN YOU ALREADY LOOK AT
Widgets for the Home and Lock Screen. Complications on your Apple Watch. A Live Activity that runs while you are out, with a sunscreen reminder. Controls and Siri: "Is it a good time to go out?" answers without opening anything.

BUILT FOR TWO PARENTS
Share with a partner or a grandparent through iCloud. A handoff card sums up the day in a form someone else can read in ten seconds. Everything syncs through your own iCloud account.

BABI+
Free forever: today's answer, the outfit in every mode, the next good window, the TOG calculator, one manual diaper list, one manual daycare list, the handoff card, the first-foods and allergen log, and exporting or deleting your data.

Babi+ adds daycare automation, the full 48-hour outlook, planning any outing, the travel pack, widgets, the Watch app, Live Activities, family sharing and more than one baby. Weekly, monthly, yearly or a one-time Lifetime purchase — all of them covered by Family Sharing, so one purchase covers both parents.

MADE TO BE LOOKED AT WHILE HOLDING A BABY
Big type, round shapes, and two small characters who show you the answer before you read it: a moon for tonight, a star for a finished bag. Full Dynamic Type, VoiceOver on every screen, and nothing that relies on colour alone — every state is an icon and a word.

PRIVACY
Babi has no account and no analytics. Your baby's details live in your own iCloud, or only on your device if you prefer. Location is approximate and used only to look up local conditions — you can pick a city by hand instead and never grant it.

Babi provides general informational and organisational guidance for parents and caregivers. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified healthcare professional. If you are worried about your baby, contact your clinician.
